title: Reading the Tax Lines of an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking That Has Been Reworked
content:
A booking held in one of the Air Ticket Fare Brands that has been voluntarily reworked carries tax lines that no longer stand one to a traveller, and the taxes in question are read off them differently. Two readings of the booking decide it: how its tax lines compare with the travellers ticketed, and whether a voluntary change line was posted to it in the last 12 months.

## 1. The readings

| Where | The taxes in question are taken as |
| --- | --- |
| the booking carries more tax lines than travellers ticketed and at least 1 voluntary change line was posted to it in the last 12 months | the largest single tax line standing on the booking, multiplied by the travellers ticketed |
| the booking carries as many tax lines as travellers ticketed and at least 1 voluntary change line was posted to it in the last 12 months | the sum of every tax line standing on the booking |
| in every other case | no such re-reading is made |

The window is 12 months, counted back from today over the voluntary change lines posted to the booking. The tax line count is of the tax lines standing on the booking, whatever their dates.

## 2. Why the two readings differ

Where the lines outnumber the travellers, a rework has left more than one tax line per traveller, and the largest of them is the one a traveller was actually charged; it is therefore taken once for each traveller ticketed. Where the lines are as many as the travellers, each line stands for a traveller, and the whole of them is simply added up.

## 3. Worked figures, on hypothetical inputs

**More lines than travellers.** A booking with 2 travellers ticketed carries 3 tax lines of 91.20, 91.20 and 14.60 USD, and a voluntary change line posted 4 months back. The largest single tax line is 91.20 USD, taken for each of 2 travellers, giving 182.40 USD.

**Lines as many as travellers.** The same booking carries 2 tax lines of 91.20 and 14.60 USD with a change line posted 4 months back. The sum of every tax line is 105.80 USD.

**Neither reading.** The same booking carries 3 tax lines but its only voluntary change line was posted 15 months back, outside the window. No such re-reading is made.
